payload.answer: I think all questions should be answered, all the time. But I wonder whether judge's questions are worthwhile and appropriately asked. I wonder if current coding agent should get those questions and just ask its own questions to answer those questions? does that make sense? But I definitely think that judge's questions should be answered on the spot, not asking 3 per turn that doesnt really make sense? We juste have to ensure that those questions are relevant and do not ask obvious things

options.description: No more "N questions for you" at turn end. The waiting questions are still counted on your band and at the session start, and they're still asked through the question tool, three per turn. The line keeps "your answer was applied" and the checks result.
options.label: Drop the count (Recommended)

options.description: The turn ends with no plumb line at all. Applied answers, check results and a behaviour that stopped working reach you only through the band, the status card or the agent's reply.
options.label: Drop the whole line

options.description: Keep the count, but make it say what happens ("…; asked next turn"). This reverses the earlier choice to keep it a bare count.
options.label: Keep it, say what's next

payload.question: 17 judge questions about your earlier requests are waiting now. plumb asks at most three per turn, between tasks. Given that, what should happen to the turn-end "plumb: N questions for you" line?
